## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. For rendering changes, include
the backend/adapter and useful before/after evidence. State what remains untested.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe any API, model/serialization or behavior change and the corresponding
guide, example or changelog updates. Write "none" if not applicable.

## Chart behavior (when applicable)

Report coverage of initial rendering, model edits/cache behavior, picking and
selection, editable-element dragging, plot-area resizing, and PNG export at the
relevant scale. Include hover behavior and serialization round trips where
affected. Identify non-applicable items; do not mark untested behavior as verified.

Renderer verification, host integration and deployed application behavior are
separate claims. See [the contribution guide](https://github.com/shim9610/figgy/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md).
